detailed_notes.backend_health: Perfect - 147/147 tests passed. No 5xx errors in backend logs during testing.
detailed_notes.import_wizard_success: Import wizard is the star of this iteration. All 4 file types (2D/3D/4D/legacy) work correctly. Dimension chips display accurate counts. Partial dimension warning feature works as designed. Structure panel displays correctly. Mapping dropdowns functional. Export/template buttons work without errors.
detailed_notes.filter_sorting_success: Filters work correctly with proper product count updates. Multiple filters can be applied in sequence. Reset button returns to initial state (12 products). No console errors during filtering.
detailed_notes.admin_regression_success: No render loops detected in /admin/konten (0 additional API requests in 15 seconds). All admin pages load without crashes. 0 console errors.
detailed_notes.react_warnings_fixed: VERIFICATION #3 confirmed: 0 react-hooks/exhaustive-deps warnings. The fixes in ChatWidget.js, AdminContentPage.js, AdminCrmPage.js, and CartContext.js are working.
detailed_notes.testing_limitations: networkidle timeout is a common issue with modern SPAs that have continuous background activity (analytics, chat widgets, polling). This is not a user-facing bug. Users can navigate and use the app normally. For future testing, recommend using domcontentloaded + specific element waits instead of networkidle.
